slides.texte_overlay:
Rewire your brain:
6 habits that kill laziness

1. Pick tomorrow's first
task tonight
Wake up knowing
what to do. No thinking,
just starting.

2. Set a 10-minute timer
and begin
Tell yourself you can stop
when it rings.
You usually won't.

3. Phone in another room
while you work
Out of reach,
out of your head.

4. Get dressed like
you're going somewhere
Pajamas tell your brain
it's still rest time.

5. Count 5-4-3-2-1 and move
Don't debate the task.
The countdown ends
the negotiation.

6. Start with one small win
Five minutes of learning
before anything else.
Momentum does the rest.
